annotation.title_clean: Executive Order 13960: Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government
annotation.title_en: Executive Order 13960: Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President of the United States)
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order 13960 (December 2020) sets nine principles for federal agencies' non-national-security use of AI, directs OMB to issue policy guidance and a roadmap, and requires annual agency inventories of AI use cases. It contains no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nine principles: lawful, purposeful, accurate, safe/secure/resilient, understandable, responsible/traceable, monitored, transparent, accountable
OMB must publish a policy guidance roadmap within 180 days
Agencies must inventory non-classified AI use cases annually and share them publicly
Agencies must retire or bring into compliance AI inconsistent with the order
Excludes national security/defense AI; creates no enforceable private rights
